issues.message: 370 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
13 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Good bones (buttresses with stair caps, door hood, lancet windows, pews, altar) but the outside has no small props yet; fine for a shell level.
notes.roof: Roof warning is a false alarm: dark oak eaves overhang 1 at x1/x9 and the roof runs 1 past the back gable (z10); the front has no overhang because the gable rises into the bell cote. Steep spruce roof, slab ridge, dark oak eave row.
notes.life: Only some mossy cobblestone; no plants, path or lanterns outside.
notes.materials: Cobblestone plinth, stone bricks, spruce roof with dark oak eaves: coherent.

visual.summary: Level 1 is the stone chapel shell: buttressed nave on a cobblestone plinth, stepped front gable rising into an empty bell cote, hooded door, glazed lancets, pews either side of an aisle and a stone altar.
problems: Exterior is bare at this level (no lights or greenery outside); acceptable for L1, L2 adds them.
Reachability: interior floor and pews are reached; unreached places are only roof slopes, eaves, buttress caps, the door-hood top, the gable louvre slots and the bell cote top. Fine.
